newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates jump on high C. Bank rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates jump on high C. Bank rate.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were higher across the board in reaction to the six percentage-point increase in the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate to 30 percent, traders said on Tuesday.
The Central Bank on Monday raised its key rate to protect the peso against another round of speculation.
PHIBOR rates showed an inverted yield curve because of the current volatility in the market caused by Thailand's financial problems, traders noted.
"We do not see a correction at once. Only after a month will we see rates start correcting downwards," she said.
